rename.to: [ec2/azure] discovery does not work anymore from 2.0.0-beta1

body: This should be simple to fix. The `onModule(DiscoveryModule)` methods in the aws and azure plugins just need to add the provider there (the discovery module has this method now). This is what I intended, but missed it since all tests pass without this! We really need some tests here...
I still think some mocks for integs that listen on a socket is the way to go. means something on a socket in pre-integration-test and the code really treats it like AWS X service or azure Y service.

Definitely. I started playing with [this lib](https://github.com/treelogic-swe/aws-mock) (running that in a Jetty container to simulate AWS calls). Was working fine at the beginning but at the end I was missing some important methods.
I started to contribute a bit but then started something else...
